result_zh: 以 3.5–2.5 击败当时的世界冠军卡斯帕罗夫。
result_en: Defeated reigning world champion Garry Kasparov 3.5–2.5.
limitations_zh: 标准比赛时限下的六局比赛；不等于游戏已被数学求解。
limitations_en: Six-game match at standard tournament time controls; chess was not solved.

result_zh: 以 6–0 击败世界冠军村上健。
result_en: Defeated world champion Takeshi Murakami 6–0.
limitations_zh: 特定对手的六局比赛；胜赛与求解是两件事。
limitations_en: Six games against one champion; match victory is distinct from solving the game.

result_zh: 标准初始局面已被弱求解，双方完美下法的结果为和棋。
result_en: Weakly solved from the standard initial position: perfect play draws.
limitations_zh: 1994 年冠军头衔涉及 Tinsley 因病退赛，不能写成击败他；也不是所有跳棋变体都已求解。
limitations_en: The 1994 title involved Tinsley withdrawing through illness; it was not a played-out defeat. Other draughts variants are outside this claim.

result_zh: 在电视挑战赛中击败 Ken Jennings 和 Brad Rutter。
result_en: Won the televised challenge against Ken Jennings and Brad Rutter.
limitations_zh: 特定问答格式及抢答机制；不代表所有自然语言理解任务。
limitations_en: A specific quiz and buzzer format, not general language understanding.

result_zh: ImageNet 2012 测试集 top-5 错误率为 4.94%，低于论文引用的人类基线。
result_en: Reported 4.94% top-5 error, below the human reference used in the paper.
limitations_zh: 固定 1000 类分类与 top-5 指标；人类基线依赖标注者经验，不等于视觉全面超人。
limitations_en: Fixed 1,000-class, top-5 evaluation; the human reference depends on annotator experience.

result_zh: 以 4–1 击败拥有 18 个世界冠军头衔的李世石。
result_en: Defeated 18-time world title winner Lee Sedol 4–1.
limitations_zh: 19×19 无让子比赛；李世石赢下第四局。
limitations_en: 19×19 without handicap; Lee won game four.

result_zh: 在乌镇三番棋中以 3–0 击败当时排名世界第一的柯洁。
result_en: Defeated then world number one Ke Jie 3–0 at Wuzhen.
limitations_zh: 另一场围棋里程碑，不应统计成新的任务领域。
limitations_en: A second Go milestone, not a separate task domain.

result_zh: 在第二期电王战中两胜佐藤天彦名人。
result_en: Won both games against Meijin Amahiko Sato in the second Denou match.
limitations_zh: 两局正式对局；不是日本将棋被求解的证明。
limitations_en: Two official games; not a mathematical solution of shogi.

result_zh: 论文报告在 44,000 手研究中以统计显著优势击败职业玩家。
result_en: Reported a statistically significant win over professionals in a 44,000-hand study.
limitations_zh: 按研究样本与总体统计解释，不意味着每手或每个对手都赢。
limitations_en: An aggregate study result, not a win on every hand or against every individual.

result_zh: 在 120,000 手比赛中击败四位顶级职业选手。
result_en: Beat four top professionals over 120,000 hands.
limitations_zh: 限定单挑无限注规则；筹码结果不等于现金收益。
limitations_en: Heads-up no-limit format; match chips are not cash earnings.

result_zh: 修订报告：Switchboard WER 5.8% 对人类 5.9%；CallHome 11.0% 对 11.3%。
result_en: Revised report: Switchboard WER 5.8% vs 5.9%; CallHome 11.0% vs 11.3%.
limitations_zh: 采用 2017 年修订数值；换用多名转写员复核等流程，人类基线会变化。
limitations_en: Uses the February 2017 revision; stronger multi-transcriber protocols change the human reference.

result_zh: EM 为 82.650，高于榜单人类基线 82.304。
result_en: Exact Match 82.650 exceeded the listed human reference of 82.304.
limitations_zh: 该比较只针对 EM；同期 F1 仍低于人类，不能概括为阅读能力全面超人。
limitations_en: The comparison is for Exact Match; contemporaneous F1 remained below humans.

result_zh: 以 2–0 击败 TI8 冠军 OG。
result_en: Defeated TI8 champions OG 2–0.
limitations_zh: 受限英雄池和游戏规则，使用程序接口；不能外推到任意版本、完整英雄池。
limitations_en: Restricted hero pool and rules, with a programmatic interface; not arbitrary patches or all heroes.

result_zh: 三个种族均达到 Grandmaster，排名高于 99.8% 活跃玩家。
result_en: Grandmaster with all three races, ranked above 99.8% of active players.
limitations_zh: 特定版本、地图、接口与动作限制；不是击败世界冠军的证明。
limitations_en: Specific version, maps, interface and action restrictions; not proof of beating the world champion.

result_zh: 论文报告天凤平台排名高于 99.99% 的正式排名人类玩家。
result_en: Reported a rating above 99.99% of officially ranked Tenhou players.
limitations_zh: 2019 年平台实验、2020 年论文；限定日麻规则、平台及排名口径。
limitations_en: Platform experiments in 2019, paper in 2020; specific riichi rules and ranking methodology.

result_zh: 57 个游戏全部超过论文采用的人类基准分数。
result_en: Exceeded the paper’s human reference on all 57 games.
limitations_zh: 是 57 个子任务，不是 57 次击败世界冠军；各游戏分别训练，不是一个模型零样本通玩。
limitations_en: 57 subtasks, not 57 world champions; separate game training, not one zero-shot universal player.

result_zh: 在 2021 ACPT 第 1–7 题中取得最高总分，超过所有人类参赛者。
result_en: Recorded the top score on puzzles 1–7 at the 2021 ACPT.
limitations_zh: 按比赛解题计分比较；不等于获得人类决赛冠军头衔。
limitations_en: Comparison on tournament puzzle scoring, not a claim to the human finals title.

result_zh: 论文展示在指定赛车与赛道条件下超越冠军级车手。
result_en: Outraced champion drivers under the paper’s car and track conditions.
limitations_zh: 论文于 2022 年发表，关键对局在 2021 年；不是现实道路自动驾驶。
limitations_en: Published in 2022 with key races in 2021; not real-road autonomous driving.

result_zh: 与人类专家对局，在 Gravon 平台达到年度及历史前三。
result_en: Reached yearly and all-time top-three rank on Gravon against human experts.
limitations_zh: 限该平台评估；不是中国陆战棋，也不是游戏已求解。
limitations_en: Platform-specific evaluation; distinct from Chinese military chess; not solved.

result_zh: 40 局联赛中平均得分超过人类均值两倍，进入多局玩家前 10%。
result_en: Over 40 games, scored more than twice the human average and ranked in the top 10% of multi-game participants.
limitations_zh: 限定在线 blitz 赛制；人类水平强者，不是世界最强。
limitations_en: Online blitz format; strong human-level performance, not world-best.

result_zh: 与三位冠军选手实机竞速，对每位均有胜局，并取得最快比赛时间。
result_en: Won races against each of three human champions and set the fastest race time.
limitations_zh: 已知室内赛道和实验条件；不代表所有户外赛道及天气。
limitations_en: Known indoor course and experimental conditions; not all tracks or weather.

result_en: Won 13/29 matches: 100% vs beginners, 55% vs intermediates, 0% vs advanced players.
limitations_zh: 必须保留业余标签；该系统没有击败高级选手。
limitations_en: Retain the amateur label; this system did not beat advanced players.

result_zh: 论文主评估中对精英选手 5 场赢 3 场；对职业选手两场均负。
result_en: Main evaluation: won 3/5 matches against elite players; lost both matches against professionals.
limitations_zh: 采用 golden point 规则；精英组与职业组分开统计，不能写成赢了职业组。
limitations_en: Golden-point scoring; elite and professional cohorts must remain separate.
